REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. B. REGISTRY No. D 4732 Date 29/4/33）
Date April 28, 1933.
Subject (in full) Report on management and staff of the Imperial Hotel,
941 Bubbling Well Road.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by OBku o.
（批：x To Hotel Kawkag uo D. 1572）
With reference to the memo of the Officer i/c Special
Branch dated April 6, 1933, on the subject of the Imperial
Hotel, 941 Bubbling Well Road, I have to state the following :-
The present proprietors of the hotel are Messrs. P.A.
Mogilevsky and Whang Sih Ching. Mogilevsky is a Russian Jew
age 53, who was formerly connected with the Harbin staff of the
Chinese Eastern Railway. He holds a Soviet passport. Whang Sih
Ching is the compradores of Luebbert's Pharmacy, 81 Nanking Road.
He resides at No. 230 Rue Porte de L'ouest.
Although these two persons are nominally the proprietors
of the hotel the business is backed financially by the China
Finance Corporation. This corporation, in order to safeguard
their interests, insisted that the municipal licences in respect
to the premises be taken out in the name of one of their employees
named Mishunich who was virtually in charge of all financial
transactions connected with the hotel. Mishunich was recently
replaced by another employee of the China Finance Corporation,
named Orloff.
Particulars of the foreign employees of the Imperial
Hotel are given hereunder :-
Yakov Yakovlevitch Kocheshoff, employed as telephone
operator, is a Russian age 29 who was born at Semipalatinsk,
Siberia. He is a graduate of the Harbin Middle School and was
formerly employed with the "Electron Factory," Harbin. He
arrived in Shanghai in 1930 and is a cousin of Captain M. J.
Marhinin of the Russian Regiment, S.V.C.
Nikolay Eliseevitch Reiman, employed as electrician, is
a Russian (Amur Cossack), age 33 who was born at Blagoveshensk,
Siberia. He served in the ranks of the "White" Russian Army and

S.2. 特别股
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局 档案号 B. 登记号 D 4732 日期 1933年4月29日）
日期：1933年4月28日。
事由（全称）：关于静安寺路941号帝国饭店管理层及员工的报告。
撰写人：D.S. Tcheremshansky。呈报人：OBku o。
（批注：x 致 Kawkag uo 饭店 D. 1572）
兹参照特别股主管警官于1933年4月6日发出的关于静安寺路941号帝国饭店事宜的备忘录，谨陈述如下：
该饭店目前的业主为 P.A. Mogilevsky 先生和 Whang Sih Ching 先生。Mogilevsky 是一名53岁的俄籍犹太人，此前曾供职于中东铁路哈尔滨办事处。他持有苏联护照。Whang Sih Ching 是南京路81号 Luebbert 药房的买办。他居住在西门路230号。
虽然这两人名义上是饭店的业主，但该业务的资金后盾是中国金融公司（China Finance Corporation）。该公司为保障其利益，坚持要求以该公司一名名为 Mishunich 的雇员名义申领有关该场所的市政执照，Mishunich 实际上负责与饭店相关的所有财务交易。Mishunich 最近已被中国金融公司的另一名雇员 Orloff 取代。
帝国饭店外籍员工的具体情况如下：
Yakov Yakovlevitch Kocheshoff，受雇为电话接线员，是一名29岁的俄罗斯人，出生于西伯利亚塞米巴拉金斯克（Semipalatinsk）。他是哈尔滨中学的毕业生，此前曾受雇于哈尔滨“电子厂”（Electron Factory）。他于1930年抵达上海，是义勇军（S.V.C.）俄国团 M. J. Marhinin 上尉的表亲。
Nikolay Eliseevitch Reiman，受雇为电工，是一名33岁的俄罗斯人（阿穆尔哥萨克），出生于西伯利亚布拉戈维申斯克（Blagoveshensk）。他曾在“白”俄军队中服役，并

participated in the civil war in Siberia.
Anatoly Georgievitch Panchenko, employed as bookkeeper,
is a Russian age 21 who was born in the Poltaba Province.
He was formerly employed with the Chinese Eastern Railway at
Harbin and arrived in Shanghai in 1931.
The three persons mentioned above are registered with the
Russian Emigrants Committee and are reputed to be "White" Russians.
The manager of the recently opened Bar and Snack Counter of
the Imperial Hotel is one David Jacob Wolff, British subject of
Netherlands Jewish extraction, who forms the subject of Special
Branch file D-4596. He is a man of doubtful character and is
married to a Russian Jewess. Although the bar and snack counter
encourage the custom of service men it cannot be said that it is
a popular resort of men in uniform.
No Soviet agents are at present residing in the hotel.
Previous to Dec. 1932 the following suspected Soviet
agents resided in the Imperial Hotel :-
V.G. Sayadyantz, representative of "Sovkino" (U.S.S.R.
Cinematograph Syndicate) former employee of the Chinese
Eastern Railway and active communist worker (File D-4337).
He resided at the Imperial Hotel from December 12, 1932 till
February 28, 1933.
A.A. Trinko, partner of Ming Sing Co. This firm distributed
Soviet films. He is a friend of Sayadyantz and resided in the
hotel from December 12, 1932 till January 10, 1933(File D-4337).
V.K. Kudrevatoff alias Koodrevatoff, Soviet employee of
the Chinese Eastern Railway, and reported to be connected with the
Communist circle. He resided in the Imperial Hotel from
December 7, 1932 till January 10, 1933. (File D-4313).
Officer i/c Special Branch.
G. Tchereemshansky.
D. S.

Anatoly Georgievitch Panchenko，受雇为簿记员，是一名21岁的俄罗斯人，出生于波尔塔瓦省（Poltaba Province）。他此前曾受雇于中东铁路哈尔滨办事处，并于1931年抵达上海。
上述三人均在俄罗斯侨民委员会注册，据信为“白”俄人员。
帝国饭店新近开设的酒吧和小吃柜台的管理者是一名 David Jacob Wolff，系荷兰犹太裔英国臣民，其为特别股档案 D-4596 的调查对象。此人品行可疑，娶了一名俄籍犹太女子为妻。尽管该酒吧和小吃柜台鼓励军人光顾，但尚不能说它是穿制服者的热门去处。
目前没有任何苏联特工居住在该饭店内。
在1932年12月之前，下列疑似苏联特工曾居住在帝国饭店：
V.G. Sayadyantz，“苏维埃电影辛迪加”（Sovkino，苏联电影联合企业）代表，前中东铁路雇员，活跃的共产主义工作者（档案 D-4337）。他于1932年12月12日至1933年2月28日期间居住在帝国饭店。
A.A. Trinko，明兴公司（Ming Sing Co.）合伙人。该公司发行苏联电影。他是 Sayadyantz 的朋友，于1932年12月12日至1933年1月10日期间居住在饭店内（档案 D-4337）。
V.K. Kudrevatoff，别名 Koodrevatoff，中东铁路的苏联雇员，据报与共产主义圈子有联系。他于1932年12月7日至1933年1月10日期间居住在帝国饭店。（档案 D-4313）。
特别股主管警官。
G. Tchereemshansky。
D. S.

SPECIAL INQUIRY
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Memorandum S. B. REGISTRY
POLICE FORCE.
N. MUNICIPAL COUNCIL.
Shanghai, April 6, 1933
To S. 2.

Please furnish the name of the
present proprietor of the Imperial
Hotel, Bubbling Well Road. Is he
or any other member of the staff
or any of the guests in the hotel
suspected of being agents of the
III International or working for
agents of the III International?
What is known of the bar and snack
counter in this establishment to
which service men are welcome?

J. Givens
O. C. (S.B.).
S.S. Tchenovansky. O.B 7/4/33.
